rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Klaviyo's official MCP server enables AI assistants to interact with Klaviyo's marketing automation platform through both remote-hosted and local server configurations. Built by Klaviyo, it provides comprehensive tools for managing campaigns, flows, profiles, events, catalogs, and reporting data, supporting major MCP clients including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code. The server offers configurable security options including read-only mode and user-generated content filtering, with OAuth authentication for the remote server and private API keys for local deployment. This implementation is particularly valuable for marketers and developers seeking to automate campaign creation, analyze performance metrics, manage customer data, and generate marketing insights directly within AI-powered workflows.
